create_StatefulObjectCache: create a StatefulObjectCache with a create_object_function and optional destroy_object_function
get_cached_object: get an object from the cache by state, creating a new one on cache miss
cache_object: cache an object for a given state, transferring ownership to the cache
discard_object: discard an object from the cache, calling destroy_object_function if provided
destroy_cache: destroy all objects owned by the cache and clean up on shutdown
